intro.title: Green Jade Bracelets
intro.descriptionHtml: Exclusive range of bracelets beautifully strung in natural Green Jade gemstone. These bracelets are available in various making options, including in combination with Rudraksha beads. Green Jade is known for its metaphysical properties with many therapeutic and spiritual benefits. It heals and balances the Anahata Chakra, which brings unconditional love, compassion, understanding, forgiveness for self and other. Green Jade is the stone of creativity, heals guilt. Physically it aids in healing kidneys and spleen and detoxifies your body. For those suffering from bones and joints pains, especially the hips may consider using a Green Jade.
